request: The about page is a single block of prose with no structure. Add a "What you get" section to it: a second-level heading followed by a short bulleted list of three things the site includes. Keep the page readable as plain content, with no new build tooling, and make sure the site still builds.

plan.goal: Give the about page a short structured section so its content is easier to scan.

scope.title: A "What you get" section on the about page
scope.description: Add an h2 heading and a three-item list to src/pages/about.astro in the same plain Astro content style the page already uses.

steps.description:
Add an

What you get

heading to src/pages/about.astro below the existing paragraph.
Add a <ul> with three <li> items naming things the starter provides (a home page, an about page, a contact form).
Build the site and confirm the home page and about page still render.

out_of_scope.item: Moving the section content into a content collection or a data file
out_of_scope.reason: The starter has no content collections and keeps page content inline; introducing one is a structural change larger than adding a section.
The page inherits the starter's existing typography; bespoke styling is not needed to add scannable content.
